summary: Real Brokerage Inc. filed a 6-K reporting court approval of its acquisition of RE/MAX Holdings via a plan of arrangement under British Columbia law, equivalent to a US merger. Final court order granted August 21, 2026; securityholder and stockholder approvals obtained August 14, 2026; expected close August 24, 2026. Terms per the April 26, 2026 Merger Agreement, as amended June 12, 2026, are not detailed in the excerpt. The arrangement is one component of the transaction. Watch for remaining closing conditions and integration risks; risk-arb centers on closing certainty.
